meta.name: doc-coauthoring
meta.description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按结构化流程协作撰写文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要与他人协作撰写结构化的文档或提案
copy.tagline_en: Collaborate on structured documentation with a guided workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to co-author structured documents or proposals with others

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你通过三个步骤协作写文档：先收集背景信息，再逐节构思和修改，最后用新对话测试文档是否清晰易懂。
howto.when: 当你提到要写文档、提案、技术规格或类似内容时，Claude 会主动提供这个协作流程。

say.text: 帮我写一份技术规格文档，用协作流程。
say.note: Claude 会开始收集背景信息。

say.text: 我们一起来写决策文档吧。
say.note: Claude 会询问文档类型和受众等信息。

say.text: 我想起草一份提案，用结构化方式。
say.note: Claude 会启动三阶段流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through a three-stage workflow for co-authoring documents: gather context, refine each section through brainstorming and editing, then test the doc with a fresh Claude to ensure clarity.
howto.when_en: Claude offers this workflow when you mention writing documentation, proposals, technical specs, or similar structured content.

say_en.text: Help me write a technical spec using the co-authoring workflow.

say_en.note: Claude asks about document type and audience.

say_en.text: I want to draft a proposal in a structured way.
